messages:
alex: Heads up — we hit a weird one in the onboarding workshop. sample-app + JS SDK + JSON mode function-calls. Repro intermittently when the SDK refreshes auth and retries the request.

maria: Ugh. Can you share repro steps?

alex: Steps: clone sample-app, npm run dev, open /demo that triggers a function call 'create_order' with a strict JSON schema. If the token expires and the SDK retries while the model is streaming the function response, the client sometimes receives a truncated JSON chunk and the schema validation fails with `Unexpected end of JSON input`. Happens only in JS SDK in our testing so far.

jon: Does py SDK behave the same?

alex: Python seems more tolerant — it buffers until the full message before handing to the schema validator. JS streams chunks to the validator which triggers the parse error.

sam: Can you paste a minimal failing trace/log?

alex: Sure, copied from staging logs:

```
WARN auth: token refresh triggered for user=alice id=23
INFO proxy: retrying request id=abcd-1234 (retry 1)
STREAM CHUNK: {"name":"create_order","args":{"items":[{"sku":"ABC","qty":1}],"shipping":{
STREAM CHUNK: "address":"123 main st","city":"Sno",")
ERROR: schema-validator: Unexpected end of JSON input at parseChunk (schema.js:214)
```

maria: Looks like the retry replay interleaves with an in-flight stream and corrupts the JSON. We probably need to atomically replay or add a small buffer to reassemble chunks before schema validation.

jon: Agreed. In JS SDK our streaming path tries to validate as tokens arrive to enable early failures. That optimization assumes chunk boundaries don't split JSON tokens. With retries they can.

sam: Workaround for the workshop: set SDK to non-streaming mode (export RW_SDK_STREAMING=false) or disable automatic retries (export RW_SDK_RETRY=0). Not ideal but prevents the crash.

alex: I sketched a quick patch: buffer incoming stream fragments until we see a matching top-level closing brace before calling the schema validator. It's in a tiny PR for the sample-app for now so we can test onboarding flow: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sample-apps/pull/432

jon: Nice. We should also port that buffering logic into the JS SDK itself as an opt-in fallback: `streamingStrictJson: boolean` default true -> when false, SDK buffers to closing brace before validating. That would match Python behavior.

maria: Create an issue for SDK parity and link the sample-app PR. Also add an e2e test that simulates auth refresh mid-stream.

sam: Filed issue #1523: "SDK parity: streaming JSON + retry semantics causing parse errors" and attached a tiny harness that simulates chunked streams + retry.

alex: For immediate onboarding notes, I'll add a short callout in the quickstart: "If you see Unexpected end of JSON input during function-calls, try disabling streaming or retries while we roll a patch."

cli-bot: deploy job started for pr/432 -> staging (job id: deploy-7752) — https://ci.redwood-inference/internal/jobs/7752

maria: Can the patch also include diagnostic logs when a partial parse happens? Something like: `partial_json_fragment_len=... last_byte=... retry_inflight=true` so we can triage occurrences in prod.

jon: Good call. I'll add that to the SDK change and include a small unit test covering partial-chunk parse and buffering.

sam: After the PR lands, let's update the onboarding workshop script to mention the env flags and link to the issue. Avoid surprising new users. :thumbsup:

alex: Thanks everyone. I'll follow up with the workshop organizers and drop the quickfix link in the workshop channel.

maria: assigning to devex for review.

alex: cc @jon @sam — will loop back when staging deploy finishes.

cli-bot: deploy job deploy-7752: SUCCESS on staging — https://ci.redwood-inference/internal/jobs/7752/logs

sam: Verified staging — buffering fixed the live demo, no more Unexpected end of JSON input.

maria: Great. Please make sure change is in the next patch release and add a short line to the release notes about "JSON streaming + retry robustness".

alex: noted. :rocket:
